title: Lua
label: Lua
desc: A small, embeddable language built on tables, first-class functions, and cooperative coroutines.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Check the interpreter, run a file, and manage rocks

snippets.code:
# Check the installed Lua version
lua -v

# Run a script file
lua greet.lua

# Start the interactive prompt, then leave with Ctrl-D
lua

-- greet.lua
-- Usage: lua greet.lua Ada
local name = arg[1] or "world"
print("hello, " .. name)

# Install a rock for the current user

# Show the rocks available on the system

sections.title: Syntax
sections.description: Comments, blocks, locals, and the shape of everyday statements

snippets.code:
-- A comment runs to the end of the line.
--[[
  A long comment can span several lines.
]]

local name = "Ada"   -- local: visible only in this block
local age = 36

if age >= 18 and name ~= "" then
  print(name .. " is an adult")
else
  print("minor or missing name")
end

for i = 1, 3 do
  io.write(i, " ")
end
io.write("\n")

local a, b = 1, 2
a, b = b, a
print(a, b)               -- 2 1

-- Only nil and false are falsy; 0 and "" are true.
local function greet(name)
  name = name or "world"
  return "hello, " .. name
end
print(greet())            -- hello, world

print(7 // 2, 7 % 2)      -- 3 1
print(2 ^ 10)             -- 1024.0
print(1 == 1.0)           -- true

sections.title: Types
sections.description: The eight value types, integer versus float numbers, and conversions

snippets.code:
print(type(nil))                             -- nil
print(type(true))                            -- boolean
print(type(42))                              -- number
print(type(3.5))                             -- number
print(type("lua"))                           -- string
print(type({}))                              -- table
print(type(print))                           -- function
print(type(coroutine.create(function() end))) -- thread
print(type(io.stdout))                       -- userdata

print(math.type(42))                         -- integer
print(math.type(3.5))                        -- float
print(10 / 2)                                -- 5.0, division yields a float
print(10 // 2)                               -- 5, floor division keeps integers

local n = tonumber("42")        -- 42
local f = tonumber("3.14")      -- 3.14
local bad = tonumber("lua")     -- nil

print(n + 1)                    -- 43
print(f * 2)                    -- 6.28
print(bad)                      -- nil
print(tostring(42) .. "!")      -- 42!
print(math.tointeger(3.0))      -- 3
print(math.tointeger(3.5))      -- nil, not integral

-- Numeric strings convert in arithmetic, but tonumber is explicit.
print("10" + 5)                 -- 15

sections.title: Variables
sections.description: Local scope, shadowing, constants, and the global table

snippets.code:
local counter = 0

do
  local counter = 10   -- shadows the outer variable
  print(counter)       -- 10
end

print(counter)         -- 0

-- Lua 5.4: a const local cannot be assigned again.
local LIMIT <const> = 100
print(LIMIT)           -- 100

-- Globals live in the _G table.
_G.app_name = "cheatrs"
print(app_name)        -- cheatrs
print(_G.app_name)     -- cheatrs

local a, b = 1        -- b receives nil
print(a, b)           -- 1 nil

local x = 10
x = x + 5
print(x)              -- 15

for i = 1, 2 do
  local doubled = i * 2
  print(doubled)      -- 2 4
end
-- doubled no longer exists after the loop.

sections.title: Strings
sections.description: Immutable byte strings, concatenation, formatting, and patterns

snippets.code:
local s = "Lua"
print(s .. " 5.4")             -- Lua 5.4
print(#s)                      -- 3
print(s:upper())               -- LUA
print(s:lower())               -- lua
print(s:rep(2, "-"))           -- Lua-Lua

local text = "  padded  "
local trimmed = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
print(trimmed)                 -- padded

print(string.format("%s scored %d points (%.1f%%)", "Ada", 9, 87.5))
-- Ada scored 9 points (87.5%)

local date = "2026-11-04"
local y, m, d = date:match("(%d%d%d%d)-(%d%d)-(%d%d)")
print(y, m, d)                 -- 2026 11 4

for word in ("one two three"):gmatch("%a+") do
  io.write(word, " ")
end
io.write("\n")

print(("abc"):find("b"))       -- 2 2
print(("a.b.c"):gsub("%.", "/")) -- a/b/c 2

local raw = [[no \n escapes here]]
print(raw)                     -- no \n escapes here

print("tab:\tquote:\"")
print("line one\nline two")

-- %q escapes a value so it can be read back as Lua source.
print(string.format("%q", 'he said "hi"')) -- "he said \"hi\""

sections.title: Tables
sections.description: The one container: arrays, maps, insertion, sorting, and unpacking

snippets.code:
local fruits = { "apple", "banana", "cherry" }
print(#fruits)                   -- 3
print(fruits[1])                 -- apple

table.insert(fruits, "date")
table.insert(fruits, 1, "avocado")
print(table.concat(fruits, ", ")) -- avocado, apple, banana, cherry, date

print(table.remove(fruits))      -- date
print(#fruits)                   -- 4

local user = {
  name = "Ada",
  age = 36,
  ["favorite color"] = "blue",
}

user.email = "ada@example.com"
print(user.name, user["favorite color"]) -- Ada blue

for key, value in pairs(user) do
  print(key, value)
end

-- Array-like keys are visited in order with ipairs.
for index, value in ipairs({ "a", "b" }) do
  print(index, value)
end

local scores = { 42, 7, 19, 88 }

table.sort(scores)               -- ascending
print(table.concat(scores, " ")) -- 7 19 42 88

table.sort(scores, function(a, b) return a > b end)
print(table.concat(scores, " ")) -- 88 42 19 7

local first, second = table.unpack(scores)
print(first, second)             -- 88 42

local copy = { table.unpack(scores) }
print(#copy)                     -- 4

sections.title: Functions
sections.description: Named and anonymous functions, multiple returns, varargs, and methods

snippets.code:
local function divide(a, b)
  if b == 0 then
    return nil, "division by zero"
  end
  return a / b
end

local value, err = divide(10, 4)
print(value)                     -- 2.5
print(err)                       -- nil
print(divide(1, 0))              -- nil  division by zero

local function sum(...)
  local total = 0
  for _, n in ipairs({ ... }) do
    total = total + n
  end
  return total
end

print(sum(1, 2, 3, 4))           -- 10

local function greet(name, greeting)
  greeting = greeting or "hello"
  return greeting .. ", " .. name
end

print(greet("Ada"))              -- hello, Ada
print(greet("Ada", "good night")) -- good night, Ada

local account = { balance = 50 }

function account.deposit(self, amount)
  self.balance = self.balance + amount
  return self.balance
end

function account:withdraw(amount) -- implicit self
  self.balance = self.balance - amount
  return self.balance
end

print(account.deposit(account, 25)) -- 75
print(account:withdraw(10))         -- 65

sections.title: Control Flow
sections.description: Conditionals, loops, break, and goto labels

snippets.code:
local score = 82

if score >= 90 then
  print("A")
elseif score >= 80 then
  print("B")
else
  print("C")
end

for i = 1, 5, 2 do
  print(i)        -- 1 3 5
end

for i = 3, 1, -1 do
  print(i)        -- 3 2 1
end

local n = 0
while n < 3 do
  n = n + 1
  print("while", n)
end

repeat
  n = n - 1
  print("repeat", n)
until n == 0

for i = 1, 10 do
  if i % 2 == 0 then
    break
  end
  print("odd", i) -- odd 1
end

for i = 1, 5 do
  if i % 2 == 0 then
    goto continue
  end
  io.write(i, " ") -- 1 3 5
  ::continue::
end
io.write("\n")

local attempts = 0
::retry::
attempts = attempts + 1
if attempts < 3 then
  goto retry
end
print(attempts)    -- 3

sections.title: Metatables
sections.description: Operator overloading, inheritance through __index, and custom behavior

snippets.code:
local defaults = { color = "blue", size = 12 }
local settings = setmetatable({}, { __index = defaults })

print(settings.color)            -- blue
settings.color = "red"           -- writes to settings, not defaults
print(settings.color)            -- red
print(defaults.color)            -- blue
print(rawget(settings, "color")) -- red
print(rawget(settings, "size"))  -- nil

local meter = {}
meter.__index = meter

function meter.new(value)
  return setmetatable({ value = value }, meter)
end

meter.__eq = function(a, b) return a.value == b.value end
meter.__lt = function(a, b) return a.value < b.value end
meter.__le = function(a, b) return a.value <= b.value end
meter.__call = function(self, extra) return self.value + extra end

local one = meter.new(1)
local two = meter.new(2)
print(one == meter.new(1)) -- true
print(one < two)           -- true
print(one(10))             -- 11

sections.title: Closures
sections.description: Functions that keep private upvalues alive between calls

snippets.code:
local function make_counter(start)
  local count = start
  return function()
    count = count + 1
    return count
  end
end

local next_id = make_counter(100)
print(next_id())   -- 101
print(next_id())   -- 102

local other = make_counter(0)
print(other())     -- 1
print(next_id())   -- 103

local function make_account(balance)
  local function deposit(amount)
    balance = balance + amount
    return balance
  end

  local function withdraw(amount)
    if amount > balance then
      return nil, "insufficient funds"
    end
    balance = balance - amount
    return balance
  end

  return deposit, withdraw
end

local deposit, withdraw = make_account(50)
print(deposit(25))   -- 75
print(withdraw(100)) -- nil  insufficient funds
print(withdraw(30))  -- 45

local callbacks = {}
for i = 1, 3 do
  local value = i   -- fresh local for each iteration
  callbacks[i] = function()
    return value * 10
  end
end

print(callbacks[1](), callbacks[2](), callbacks[3]()) -- 10 20 30

sections.title: Coroutines
sections.description: Cooperative multitasking with create, resume, yield, and wrap

snippets.code:
local co = coroutine.create(function(a, b)
  print("start", a, b)       -- start 2 3
  local c = coroutine.yield(a + b)
  print("resumed with", c)   -- resumed with 10
  return "done"
end)

print(coroutine.status(co))   -- suspended
print(coroutine.resume(co, 2, 3)) -- true 5
print(coroutine.resume(co, 10))   -- true done
print(coroutine.status(co))   -- dead

local function range(n)
  return coroutine.wrap(function()
    for i = 1, n do
      coroutine.yield(i)
    end
  end)
end

for value in range(4) do
  io.write(value, " ")
end
io.write("\n")

local next_value = range(3)
print(next_value())   -- 1
print(next_value())   -- 2
print(next_value())   -- 3

sections.title: File I/O
sections.description: Open, read, write, append, and close files with explicit handles

snippets.code:
local out = assert(io.open("notes.txt", "w"))
out:write("first line\n")
out:write("second line\n")
out:close()

for line in io.lines("notes.txt") do
  print(line)
end

local file = assert(io.open("notes.txt", "r"))
local content = file:read("a") -- "a" reads to end of file
print(#content)                -- 23
file:close()

local f = assert(io.open("notes.txt", "r"))
print(f:read("l"))             -- first line
f:seek("set", 0)
print(f:read(5))               -- first
f:close()

local log = assert(io.open("app.log", "a"))
log:write(os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), " started\n")
log:close()

local ok, err = os.remove("missing.txt")
print(ok == nil, err ~= nil) -- true true

sections.title: Common Errors
sections.description: Nil indexing, 1-based arrays, aliasing, and type mistakes

snippets.code:
local config = nil
-- print(config.name) -- error: attempt to index a nil value

config = { name = "app" }
print(config.name)    -- app

local list = { 10, 20, 30 }
-- print(list[0])     -- nil: arrays start at index 1
print(list[1])        -- 10

local total = 10
local input = "5"
local n = tonumber(input)
if n then
  print(total + n)     -- 15
else
  print("not a number")
end

local name = nil
-- print("hello " .. name) -- error: attempt to concatenate a nil value
print("hello " .. tostring(name)) -- hello nil

-- Different types never compare equal.
print(1 == "1")        -- false
print(nil == false)    -- false
print(1 ~= 2)          -- true
